description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy (%) of various models across three different domains: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The models compared are DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO, each represented by a distinct bar pattern and color as indicated in the legend. For Mathverse, the accuracy values are approximately 53.1% for DAPO, 56.2% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 55.8% for SRPO, 54.5% for PPO, and 53.5% for PPO+Self-reflection. In the MMLU domain, the accuracies are around 55.9% for DAPO, 56.9% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 57.1% for SRPO, 56.3% for PPO, and 54.6% for PPO+Self-reflection. For Physics, the accuracies are approximately 57.5% for DAPO, 60.9% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 60.6% for SRPO, 59.3% for PPO, and 57.0% for PPO+Self-reflection. Across all domains, DAPO+Self-reflection consistently achieves the highest accuracy, followed by SRPO, while DAPO generally shows the lowest accuracy among the models presented.
